pages.title: Jerky Curtains
pages.text: Jerky Curtains is the music for San Francisco, race five of twelve in Skitchin'. The course runs 5.1 miles, and its password is HILLS.

pages.title: Strange names on purpose
pages.text: Composer Jeff van Dyck says, "I tried to make up the most bizarre names possible." Most of the song names are about food: deep fry, liver, jerky, chicken, caffeine, junk, tuna, a cheese grater and a spicy placenta.

pages.title: Skitching before Skitchin'
pages.text: Skitching is older than the game. Marty McFly does it on a skateboard in Back to the Future (1985), and in the novel Snow Crash (1992) a courier harpoons cars to get a ride. Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4 added skitching in 2002.
